abstract: Maintains dock door availability schedules and dedicated standard chilled cross-dock capacity quotas
system_message:
You are Warehouse Operations Director (WOD). The Warehouse Operations Director (WOD) manages cross-dock physical throughput operations, tracking dedicated receiving dock door availability, standard chilled slot quotas, and receiving pallet inversion equipment performance across candidate facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Pallet Inversion Workflows（PALLET）
information_points.content:
WOD-PALLET-4ZX：Pallet transfer audit logs indicate that Decentralized Urban Spoke Hub operates with an automated pallet inverter cycle rate of 35 cycles/h on its receiving staging line invertor units.
WOD-PALLET-K5Y：Pallet transfer audit logs for Integrated Central Mega-Depot show an automated pallet inverter cycle rate of 55 cycles/h across the receiving staging line invertor units.
WOD-PALLET-RBN：According to pallet transfer audit logs for Shared Multi-Tenant Logistics Campus, the receiving staging line invertor units achieve an automated pallet inverter cycle rate of 45 cycles/h.

information_points.title: Maintains dock door availability schedules and dedicated standard chilled cross-dock capacity quotas（DOCK）
information_points.content:
WOD-DOCK-X9L：According to the terminal apron allocation plan for Shared Multi-Tenant Logistics Campus, 10 doors are allocated as dedicated cross-dock receiving doors for the 04:00 to 09:00 dairy morning intake window. Concurrently, the terminal throughput allotment table specifies a dedicated standard chilled slot quota of 650 pallets/day across the daily dairy transshipment operating window.
WOD-DOCK-00B：For Decentralized Urban Spoke Hub, the terminal apron allocation plan designates 4 doors as dedicated cross-dock receiving doors during the morning intake window from 04:00 to 09:00. In addition, its terminal throughput allotment table sets a dedicated standard chilled slot quota of 550 pallets/day during the daily dairy transshipment operating window.
WOD-DOCK-832：At Integrated Central Mega-Depot, the terminal apron allocation plan reserves 10 doors for dedicated cross-dock receiving doors during the daily dairy morning cross-dock intake window (04:00 to 09:00). Furthermore, its terminal throughput allotment table establishes a dedicated standard chilled slot quota of 450 pallets/day for the daily dairy transshipment operating window.
